title: Process: turning used cooking oil into biodiesel

writing.prompt: The diagram below shows how used cooking oil is collected and turned into biodiesel fuel.

visual.description: Process diagram titled "Turning used cooking oil into biodiesel", with eight numbered stages linked by arrows and one by-product. Stage 1: used oil is collected from restaurants. Stage 2: it is filtered to remove food scraps. Stage 3: it is heated to remove water. Stage 4: it is mixed with alcohol and a catalyst in a reactor. Stage 5: the mixture is left to settle and two layers form. From stage 5 the process divides: the bottom layer (glycerine) is separated as a by-product and sold to soap makers (shown in a dashed box, not numbered), while the top layer (biodiesel) continues to stage 6, where it is washed with water. Stage 7: the biodiesel is dried and stored in tanks. Stage 8: it is supplied as fuel for city buses.
